name: Boundary Face Center Value Adjustment
aliases: Modifying the center value of a boundary face
definition: A technique to ensure continuity of the isosurface at multiresolution boundaries by modifying the scalar value at the center vertex of a boundary face. It solves the problem where the isosurface intersects opposite edges of a face, causing cracks if the high-resolution isoline does not pass through specific intersection points.
summary: Boundary Face Center Value Adjustment modifies scalar data at boundary face centers to ensure isosurface continuity across resolution levels, distinguishing itself by altering data rather than post-processing mesh geometry.
